title: WorkRewardFundType - Data API
description: Represents the type of WorkRewardFund object.

CreditSystem.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
CreditSystem.description: The credit system that is used by the WorkRewardFundType object (gift codes or points). If points are selected, the reward message will not consider the CurrencyCode field.

CurrencyCode.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
CurrencyCode.description: The currency code of the WorkRewardFundType

IsActive.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsActive.description: Whether the WorkRewardFundType is active and available in the UI

IsPredefined.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort
IsPredefined.description: Whether the WorkRewardFundType is predefined (true) or not (false)

LastReferencedDate.description: The time stamp that indicates when the current user last viewed a record that is related to this WorkRewardFundType.

LastViewedDate.description: The time stamp that indicates when the current user last viewed this WorkRewardFundType. If this value is null, this record might have been only referenced (LastReferencedDate) and not viewed.

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: The ID of the WorkRewardFundType owner

RedemptionDisclaimer.description: The redemption disclaimer text for the WorkRewardFundType

RedemptionUrl.description: The URL that’s linked to the redemption

UploadCodeColumn.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
UploadCodeColumn.description: The column where the reward code is contained in the CSV file. The upload uses the second value by default.

UploadValueColumn.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
UploadValueColumn.description: The column where the reward value is contained in the CSV file. The upload uses the third column by default.

associated_objects:
This object has the following associated objects. Unless noted, they are available in the same API version as this object.

- **WorkRewardFundTypeFeed**: Feed tracking is available for the object.
- **WorkRewardFundTypeHistory**: History is available for tracked fields of the object.
- **WorkRewardFundTypeOwnerSharingRule**: The original WDC feature is unavailable as of Spring '22. This object isn't available as of API version 54.0. For more information, see Phased WDC (legacy Work.com) Feature Retirement.
- **WorkRewardFundTypeShare**: Sharing rules are available for the object.
